There's no better source for all your WaterSport needs than us and of course we are pet friendly. So the entire family can come enjoy everything our beautiful Indian River has to offer. "I highly recommend GT Luxury Water Sports! Jay was amazing! He was showing us a good time. We saw dolphins and manatees. Made a lot of memories on my 25th birthday with the family.
